name: Adygea
summary_text: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta), checked against the dossier and fetched sources: a North Caucasus republic, within the region that foreign travel advisories name as dangerous for LGBT+ people, where monitors report 'no safe life' for LGBT+ residents; the federal 'extremism' machinery applies nationwide (101 convictions by June 2025). Scored relative to the national score (0.12) for Russia.

sources.title: Country policy and information note: sexual orientation and gender identity and expression, June 2025 (accessible) - GOV.UK
sources.claim_summary: UK Home Office country policy and information note on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression (June 2025): LGB people generally not assessed as at state-persecution risk, but North Caucasus residents, trans people and public LGBT+ activists likely face persecution; same-sex marriage and gender transition banned, trans healthcare effectively banned 2023, no discrimination protections; at least 139 people affected by anti-LGBT laws 2022-2024.

NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (Cloudflare block); the underlying US State Department travel advisory for Russia covers general travel safety and, per the research dossier, the North Caucasus republics and interior-permission entry regimes.

sources.title: Russia: Rising Toll of LGBT ‘Extremism’ Designation | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch news report (30 June 2025): 101 'extremism' convictions for alleged participation in the banned international LGBT movement or display of its symbols - 98 administrative, 3 criminal; 20 criminal cases January 2024-June 2025 (2 prison sentences, 1 death in pretrial detention, 17 pending); 81 people convicted of administrative symbol offenses since January 2024, most of them on Russia's largest social media platform (61); publishing-house staff charged May 2025 facing up to 12 years.
